title: Representation-Aware Advantage Estimation: Your Reward Model Provides More Than A Scalar Output

live_model.evidence: "average scores using GPT-4-Turbo as the judge" (Sec. 5.2, MT-Bench); "using GPT-4.1 as the judge" (AlpacaEval 2.0 win-rate against GPT-4-0314)

prompt.note: Uses third-party benchmark harnesses (AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, Arena-Hard-v0.1); no GPT-4-Turbo prompt text is shown, only that it serves as automated judge.

claim.metric: none for the live id (it grades the authors' own Qwen2.5-7B/Llama-3-8B + GraphAE outputs, not its own performance)
claim.location: Table 1 (main results use GPT-4-Turbo/GPT-4.1 only as judges of the authors' models)

data.source: AlpacaEval 2.0, MT-Bench, Arena-Hard-v0.1 (public benchmarks); training data is public instruction-tuning data

notes: GPT-4-Turbo and GPT-4.1 are used purely as LLM judges (role A) to score the authors' own reward-modeling method; no experiment reports GPT-4-Turbo's own task performance as a subject or baseline model.
